author: (Linnaeus, 1758)
evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic; range includes the continental Caribbean coast
Listed as "sargo rojo" in the 2010 Rev. Biol. Trop. field guide
No local iNaturalist, OBIS or GBIF record found

note.en: A deep-shelf porgy listed for the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica in a regional field guide, with no local record and usually found well below normal diving depth.
note.es: Un sargo de la plataforma profunda que una guía regional registra para el Caribe de Costa Rica, sin registro local y que suele vivir muy por debajo de la profundidad normal de buceo.

sources.t: Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2) 2010, field guide to the marine fishes of Caribbean Costa Rica, Sparidae page

marks.en: Pinkish-red, deep-bodied sea bream with silvery sheen, a steep forehead and a forked tail.
marks.es: Sargo rosado rojizo de cuerpo alto con brillo plateado, frente empinada y cola ahorquillada.
